prerequisites: Knowledge of basic issues and methods in the field of algebra and maths analysis at secondary school level

learning_outcomes.text: gaining knowledge and skills in the field of differential calculus and total function of one variable, linear algebra, analytic geometry, differential calculus functions of two variables, solving basic types of differential equations
using the learned mathematical apparatus to solve problems occurring in directional issues, use of Matlab to present the content of lectures.

has knowledge in mathematics concerning: algebra, mathematical analysis, probability theory and selected numerical methods, including the knowledge necessary for: modeling and analysis of mechanical systems; performing calculations in the design of technological processes; description and prediction of operating characteristics of technical equipment, technical facilities and systems;
can use analytical, simulation and experimental methods to formulate and solve engineering tasks.
is ready to complete and critically evaluate specialized knowledge and is able to select sources of knowledge and methods of learning appropriate for himself/herself and others;
is willing to comprehensively analyze and effectively carry out assigned tasks, and in the event of difficulties in solving them, use expert opinion;

assessment_methods.method: Engagement for promotional and teaching activities Faculty (related to course content) (Exercises)

assessment_rules: The condition for passing the exercises is attendance (allowed missing two classes per semester) and achieving required educational results. The final grade for exercises is the sum of assessments from two colloquiums in the semester. Students can earn extra points for activity in classes (0.5 points per plus) and for engagement in promotional and teaching activities. Assessment of the lecture is based on a written credit in the first semester and a written exam in the second semester. Obtaining positive grades from all forms of classes is equivalent to course completion.
